

When you are done, end your reply with exactly one result block and print the two marker lines only there, each alone on its line:
ORCA_RESULT_BEGIN nonce0123456789abcdef
{"schema_version":1,"status":"done|blocked|failed|needs_info","summary":"","files_changed":[],"checks_run":[{"id":"the command you ran","exit":0}],"questions":[],"notes":""}
ORCA_RESULT_END nonce0123456789abcdef
status is done only when the work is finished; use needs_info with at least one question when you cannot continue without an answer, blocked when something outside the task stops you, failed when you could not do it. No other keys.
